title: Frozen circular slot-transport failure attribution
purpose: Determine why the sealed slot-transport ensemble improves coarse multi-exit recovery but fails strict two-degree localization and safe whole-set refusal before selecting any corrective method.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training audit of sealed C07/C08 Teacher and three-seed predictions; no new inference, checkpoint change, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed circular peak-field Teacher for C07/C08.
Sealed three-seed cardinality-conditioned circular slot-transport development predictions.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Only the 20 frozen C07/C08 development worlds are read; C01-C06 are provenance-only and not read.

sampling.rule: Audit every sealed observation exactly once. Decoder variants are predeclared: circular mean, bin argmax, and argmax plus immediate-neighbour local circular mean; no target-dependent selection.

teacher.source: Frozen exact circular exit-center bins and signed sub-bin residuals.
teacher.valid_mask: All presence peaks define bearing targets; no missing bearing target is imputed.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: The audit creates no node or edge and calls no planner. Teacher identity is absent and cannot enter decoding.

split.historical_pollution_audit: No weights, logits or thresholds are changed. C07 may select a frozen confidence threshold solely to quantify transfer; C08 applies it once and cannot revise the diagnosis.
split.selection: C07 selects each predeclared confidence feature's maximum-recall operating point at exit precision at least 0.995.
split.transfer: The exact C07 threshold is applied once to C08.

methods.main: Frozen-output attribution comparing three single seeds and the aligned ensemble, mean/argmax/local-mode decoding, oracle-cardinality diagnostic, cardinality-stratified error, target-neighbourhood mass, seed disagreement, entropy, concentration, peak mass and margins.
methods.baseline: Formal ensemble circular-mean exact-set fractions and the prior single-intensity failure-attribution results.
methods.fallback: If invariants fail, seal system FAIL. If no predeclared simple cause explains both C07 and C08, conclude strict slot-distribution localization plus confidence failure and require a representation-level corrective rather than post-processing.

failure_policy: Do not train, infer, widen tolerances, lower precision, use oracle cardinality as deployment, add confidence features after seeing C08, or enter graph/planner. Any join or population drift stops the run.
retention: Retain summary, decoder table, attribution figures/source, environment, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal. The sealed three-seed checkpoints/predictions remain in their source run.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only read and deterministic attribution over 45,942 frozen observations
